people.name: Shechem
people.line: City in Canaan, later allotted to Ephraim

translations.web: When all the men of the tower of Shechem heard of it, they entered into the stronghold of the house of Elberith.
translations.bsb: On hearing of this, all the leaders in the tower of Shechem entered the inner chamber of the temple of El-berith.
translations.kjv: And when all the men of the tower of Shechem heard that, they entered into an hold of the house of the god Berith.
translations.asv: And when all the men of the tower of Shechem heard thereof, they entered into the stronghold of the house of Elberith.
